purpose: Bindings, thin owned activation adapters and version-neutral global discovery.
use: Opening a bound workspace or repairing the thin activation adapter: rediscover the binding and run the current entry contract without copied rules.
semantic_conditions: Adapters carry activation pointers only; another runtime adapter is never altered or trusted as proof.
mandatory_preconditions: Persistent workspace binding and current verified entry/bootstrap reference.
postconditions_verification: Owned adapter resolves the current binding; stale references self-healed or reported as blockers.
